T: Road trip. Fishing rods. Snacks for the whole drive.
D: Goofy drags his teenage son Max on a cross-country fishing trip just as Max is trying to impress Roxanne.
P: Serve the mains when Goofy and Max finally make camp by Lake Destiny.
S: the father and son fishing move, Lake Destiny in Idaho
White fish strips dipped in flour, egg and panko, fried at 180C for 3 minutes until golden, with lemon wedges and a quick tartare of mayo, pickles and capers.
Lake Destiny is in Idaho, so potatoes it is
Russet potatoes cut into thick wedges, tossed with oil, paprika and garlic salt, roasted at 220C for 35 minutes until crisp, sour cream and chives for dipping.
the map Max quietly redraws to head for LA
Roasted peanuts, pretzel pieces, raisins, chocolate buttons and dried apple tipped into a big bowl and portioned into paper bags for the car.
M: Pete and PJ's campsite, with the giant RV
Thick beef sausages grilled over coals until charred, in soft rolls with fried onions, mustard and tomato sauce, corn on the cob on the side.
the night the camp gets a visit from Bigfoot
Diced beef browned in a big pot with onion and smoked paprika, simmered with kidney beans, tomato and stock for two hours, served with crusty bread.
W: Bigfoot helps himself to everything at the campsite
Toast marshmallows over a flame until golden and squash them between plain biscuits with a square of milk chocolate so it melts.
K: Max and Roxanne at the big concert in LA
Cherry cordial blended with lots of ice and a squeeze of lime until slushy, served in tall cups with a straw.

s.note: the father and son fishing move, Lake Destiny in Idaho
s.how: Cut 600g white fish fillets into fingers. Dip in 50g flour, then 2 beaten eggs, then 120g panko. Fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden and drain. Mix 150g mayonnaise with 2 chopped dill pickles and 1 tbsp capers for tartare and serve with lemon wedges.

s.note: the map Max quietly redraws to head for LA
s.how: Tip 150g roasted peanuts, 100g mini pretzels, 100g raisins, 100g chocolate buttons and 80g chopped dried apple into a big bowl and toss together. Portion into 4 paper bags, fold the tops over and keep them in the car for the long drive.

m.note: Pete and PJ's campsite, with the giant RV
m.how: Grill 8 thick beef sausages over hot coals or a barbecue for 12 minutes, turning, until charred. Fry 2 sliced onions in oil until soft and sweet. Grill 4 corn cobs for 10 minutes and brush with butter. Serve the sausages in 8 long rolls with the onions, yellow mustard and tomato sauce.

w.note: Bigfoot helps himself to everything at the campsite
w.how: Toast 16 large marshmallows on skewers over a gas flame or under a hot grill until golden. Squash each between 2 plain biscuits with a square of milk chocolate, 32 biscuits and 200g chocolate in total, and leave 30 seconds so the chocolate starts to melt.

d.note: Max and Roxanne at the big concert in LA
d.how: Blend 200ml cherry cordial with 600g ice, 200ml cold water and the juice of 1 lime until smooth and slushy. Pour into 4 tall cups and serve straight away with straws before it melts.
